description: Waste Collection Schedule is an open-source add-on for the Home Assistant home automation system that reads household waste collection dates from the web sites and calendar files of waste service providers. Its value for infrastructure studies is the provider list and the connectors themselves: the README lists about 3,800 entries, covering councils, municipal utilities and private collectors in 31 countries, from Australia and much of Europe to Canada, the United States, Japan, South Africa and Uruguay, each with a source module that returns collection dates by waste type for an address. Schedules are refreshed daily from the providers' sites or derived from their iCal files. The code is free to download from GitHub under the MIT licence, and a copy is also on GitLab. Caveats: it returns dates, not tonnages or routes, the connectors break when providers change their sites, some providers are listed more than once, and coverage is densest in Germany and other European countries. Coverage is multinational. Simulation uses: deriving collection frequencies and service patterns by area as inputs to waste collection and disruption models. Related records: the What a Waste global database (data-what-a-waste-global-database) supplies the quantities collected.
